product.description: light-field image panel: modular, bezel-less holographic display panels about 28 inches (0.7 m) across, tiled into a surface of any size, whose light is the image they are fed; the room lays the panels over its faces and gives each face's extent
product.codeBasis: the maker's platform name; the panels are made to order

housing.dimensionBasis: panels about 28 inches across, tiled without bezels; the room gives each face's extent
